observations: Three photos show a split air conditioner unit with both indoor and outdoor components stacked together.
The brand 'KENSTAR' is visible on both the indoor and outdoor units in all three photos.
The indoor unit is white, with a horizontal vent and control panel area.
The outdoor unit has a metal grille and visible fan housing.
The unit appears to be placed outdoors on a concrete surface, next to a vehicle tire.
There is no visible remote, water hose, or indoor hanger in the photos.
No model number or capacity label is visible on the unit in any photo.
The unit shows some minor surface dirt and wear, especially on the outdoor unit's grille.

claims.evidence: Photos show some dirt and wear, especially on the outdoor unit. No clear evidence of 'super clean' condition. The 1.5hp claim is unverifiable_remote as no model or capacity label is visible.
No pressure gauge or refrigerant check visible. Cannot verify gas level remotely.

claims.claim: remote, water hose and indoor hanger
claims.evidence: None of these accessories are visible in any of the three photos.

risks.risk: Unit may not be 1.5hp as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the model label or capacity sticker on the unit
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower capacity unit (e.g., 1hp) or unknown capacity

risks.risk: Refrigerant gas may be low or depleted
risks.proof: Photo of refrigerant pressure gauge reading or service tag showing gas level
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or requiring gas recharge

risks.risk: Unit may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Video of unit running or close-up of internal components (coils, fan, compressor)
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or requiring repair

risks.risk: Missing accessories (remote, water hose, indoor hanger)
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories included with the unit
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value

proof_requests: Photo of the model label or capacity sticker on the unit
Photo of the refrigerant pressure gauge or service tag
Video of the unit running or close-up of internal components
Photo showing the remote, water hose, and indoor hanger included
response.reason: The brand is identifiable as KENSTAR, but the model and capacity are not visible. Key claims about 1.5hp, full gas, and included accessories cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks include incorrect capacity, low refrigerant, internal damage, and missing accessories. These must be proven before pricing can be determined.
